title: Definition.
bodyText: In this chapter "foreign judgment" means any judgment, decree, or order of a court of the United States or of any other court which is entitled to full faith and credit in this State.
bodyHtml: [§636C-2]  Definition.  In this chapter "foreign judgment" means any judgment, decree, or order of a court of the United States or of any other court which is entitled to full faith and credit in this State. [L 1983, c 31, pt of §1]
